final: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB*1.0/HCT) AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT<>0 GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM p), g AS (SELECT p.ID, p.r, p.r-o.a AS d1 FROM p, o WHERE p.r>o.a), ga AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS b FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(g.d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(g.r-ga.b) AS avg_above_group FROM g, ga WHERE g.r>ga.b
